canonical.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
canonical.sourceFilePath: 09. Heaps/2. Medium Problems/01. Kth largest element.cpp

narrative.title: The Leaderboard Podium Scan
narrative.scenario: An esports backend tracks player scores in arrival order, and the broadcast needs the kth-highest score without sorting the entire leaderboard. A small holding pen keeps only the k best scores seen so far, always evicting its weakest resident whenever a stronger score arrives. When the scan ends, the pen's weakest resident is exactly the kth-highest score overall.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer array nums and an integer k.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the kth largest element of nums.

testCases.explanation: Only 6 outranks 5, so 5 is the second-highest score.
The scores above 4 are 6, 5, 5 — making 4 the fourth-largest.

hintLevels: Level 1: Keep only k candidates — anything entering the pen must beat its weakest resident.
Level 2: A min-heap of size k exposes the weakest of the best k at the top in O(1).
Level 3: After the scan the heap's top IS the answer — no sorting of the full array ever happens.
